versionRule: Controller must bind the official supported Comet version/artifact and actual public API before any new image build or runtime start. Existing0.4.5/6da inputs are a preserved current-lock snapshot, not approval of a new SDK. No0.4-specific bootstrap is added.

cachedNodeBase.scope: read-only local metadata; current runtime version/source use must be independently read back

pythonIfRequiredByChosenRecipe.scope: public metadata only; proposed dependency, not pulled or admitted

proposedCommandsNotExecuted.purpose: local allowlisted export after selected source is rebound
build from the newly frozen allowlist, never checkout root

beforeExecution: Root official version/artifact binding and independent construction review
revise/freeze the executable Dockerfile recipe for that exact artifact/toolchain; current old source-build recipe is not approved for new use
exact context manifest and all public inputs present/hash verified; no floating install or hidden fallback network
current fixed engine/context/authority/workspace/image/bootstrap identities independently read back; current examples remain null
P1_3 installs a fixed protected bootstrap and uses the selected version public runtime/application factories; job JSON cannot choose consumer/principal/role/mount
I01 owner/resource record and purpose-bound role eligibility; current4refs are not provisioned
preflight new namespace absent or exactly owned; never touch oldcomet-runner resources
actualQualificationRecipe: first actual built image digest/source/version/platform/import readback, with local Node/Git/Python/package tools as required by the selected version
actual namespace/mount/read-only/mincap inspection plus Shell requests/errno; neither configured user nor same UID is qualification
Edit and MCP require their actual registered tool/transport/executor and raw request/error; ordinary fs writes cannot be relabeled
one original fixed Comet Run/workspace/authority with authenticated role results, owner death/late result/duplicate writer/copied state refusal and same-original operation recovery
unknown completion reads back original execution/container; observation timeout does not terminate a process or create another operation
rollback: stop only the exact original authorized execution after current image/labels/engine/mount verification
preserve raw stdout/stderr/inspect/Run evidence before any later cleanup
remove only explicitly owned new qualification resources after Root closeout; old containers/volumes/Run and business stores remain intact
missingAuthorizations: no secret provisioning or signing grant
